Name: Stardew ATM
Author: ThatBritishMo
Description:
[size=4][u]See changelog for updates[/u]

[u]If you'd like to contribute a translation for this mod, please feel free to either reach out and we'll add it to the files, or you can create your own. See below for language contributors. 
[/u]
Stardew ATM allows you to deposit and withdraw money from your Zuzu City bank account. [/size]
[size=4]You can now store your money safely, without keeping large amounts in your pockets. [/size]
[size=4]This can be handy when you are saving up to purchase tool upgrades or commission Robin to build your next farm building.[/size]

[size=4][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/43744/43744-1773708984-2060084334.png[/img][/size]

[size=4]Those who play co-op may also see the benefit of this feature, because you are able to ensure that no one on the farm accidentally spends the money that was intended for something specific. In co-op mode all players can access the ATM however each player has their own bank account.[/size]

[size=4]Another positive: the less money you have in your pockets, the less money Dr. Harvey can steal from you because you passed out on your own property. [/size]

[size=4]On Day 1, the Zuzu City bank sends you a letter about your change of address. [/size]
[size=4]They send you the blueprints for the ATM as well as a battery pack. This ensures that you can make an ATM before you would otherwise obtain your first battery pack in-game; all you need to do is acquire the 200 stone required for the recipe.[/size]

[size=4][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/43744/43744-1773708990-1927643777.png[/img][/size]

[size=4]Note: the battery pack sent with the ATM blueprint is provided with the intent that it will be used to make your first ATM. All subsequent ATMs require you to have all the materials necessary for the recipe.
All ATMs are linked and even if you destroy them all you won't lose your money. You can place one at the mines and one at your farm and access your money from any location![/size]

[size=5]Installation Instructions[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Unzip the contents of the download file in the Stardew/Mods/ folder[/size]
[*][size=3]You will need SMAPI and Content Patcher[/size]
[/list]
